name: Suicide
overview: Scripture upholds the sanctity of life, as seen in the commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13), affirming that life is precious and not to be taken by our own hand. The story of Samson demonstrates a complex instance of self-sacrifice in the face of enemy oppression (Judges 16:29-30), while the Psalms reveal God's compassionate care for those suffering deep sorrow and brokenness, promising deliverance and healing for the brokenhearted (Psalms 13:2; 34:17; 147:3). These passages together emphasize that God hears the cries of the afflicted and offers hope beyond despair.
